question: Can the deterministic bounded-drift base safely replace PrefixGraph's complete anchor tournament while preserving exact complete-artifact minimum bytes?
prediction: No. There exists a generic deterministic family where bounded drift's min-SHA base is not PrefixGraph's complete-artifact best anchor and forcing it regresses bytes.
stronger_control: Current PrefixGraph complete anchor tournament over every admissible anchor.

kill_or_advance.falsify_shortcut: Any deterministic family with forced bounded-drift-base PrefixGraph bytes > best-tournament PrefixGraph bytes.
kill_or_advance.advance_shortcut: Only if exhaustive/adversarial evidence plus a proof establishes equivalence; a finite green corpus alone is insufficient.

claim_boundary: Mechanism-level ownership falsifier only; no product/release credit.
